feat(collector): the host's collector holds each session's world state and hands it to the renderer (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.kcp)

A session's lanes and the stamp of its world state move to the host. One
collector record per session declares the built-in lanes at the keys its
newest request names and each plugin source the renderer's last output
subscribed to, stamps one world state from what they hold, and hands every
stamp that moved to the renderer as a `world-state` event. A request is
delivered on arrival with the world state read at its own keys. The
renderer keeps a world-state store its views read, answers `retire` by
closing the session's view, and says on every output which plugin sources
its open views need read. The session's lifetime is the collector's sweep:
a session no request named across a whole sweep, with no open feed, is
retired.

The view no longer declares, holds or stamps, and the render cache's idle
sweep is gone; a request's wait reads the world-state store.
refactor(facts): the facts document is WorldState, the seam between the host and a renderer (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.kcp)
